args.body: Thank you for your email. On the dog flap: the inspection report notes the tenants have fitted one in the back door (utility room). We have no record of it being approved, so we are asking the tenant when and why it was fitted. Please tell us whether you would like it removed and the door made good, or whether you are willing to consent to it staying. On the spare front door key: we are checking with the tenant whether the lock was changed and who holds keys, and will report back. Your email was signed Felix Clarke but our record addresses Oliver Bennett, so could you confirm who you are writing as? We will update you once we have the tenant's answer.
